clue.text: Live on the edge

parts.note: on means about or concerning, the crossword's RE
an edge is the side of something

explanation.surface: An instruction or description of someone living on the margins, on the brink of things.
explanation.definitionFit: To live somewhere is to dwell there, a plain synonym for the verb.

clue.text: Chicken roll has nothing in it

indicators.note: the zero is put within the list, since the roll has it in it

parts.note: a roll is a list of names, a roster
nothing is zero, shaped like the letter O

explanation.surface: A chicken bread roll with no filling at all.
explanation.definitionFit: A cockerel is a male chicken, so the bird is an example of the defined fowl.

clue.text: Market carrying soft fur

indicators.note: the market word holds the soft letter, carrying it within

parts.note: a sale is a market event where goods are sold
B marks a soft pencil lead

explanation.surface: A market stall selling soft furs.
explanation.walkthrough: B, the grade for soft (black) pencil leads, goes inside SALE.
explanation.definitionFit: The pelt of a small dark-furred mammal is prized as a luxury fur.

clue.text: Cloth is enough for flesh and blood

parts.note: 'that does' means that is enough or suffices
your own flesh and blood are your family or kin

explanation.surface: A cloth of fair quality will do for family members.
explanation.definitionFit: A soft leather or a fine woollen fabric with a smooth finish goes by this name.

clue.text: American soldiers grabbed by painting of biblical mount

indicators.note: the soldiers and American are held inside the painting word, grabbed by it

parts.note: painting is art
RA is the Royal Artillery, a body of soldiers

explanation.surface: US troops seize a picture of a mountain from the Bible.
explanation.walkthrough: RA, the Royal Artillery, is a standard crossword source of soldiers; the inserted letters sit just before the painting word's last letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Noah's ark came to rest on the mountains of this name in Genesis.

clue.text: Soldier's uniform

definitions.meaning: a professional soldier in a standing army, as opposed to a reservist
uniform means even, steady, the same throughout

explanation.surface: A soldier's kit, the clothing he wears.
explanation.definitionFit: A career soldier of the standing army is one; even and steady things are this too.

clue.text: Two lists can be alternated

parts.note: a rota is a list of duties
a table is a list of data in columns

explanation.surface: Two lists that may be swapped in turn.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that can be rotated can be turned or alternated in sequence.

clue.text: Restrain and draw swallow

parts.note: a draw in sport is a tie
to down a drink is to swallow it

explanation.surface: Holding back and then gulping a drink drawn from a tap.
explanation.definitionFit: To fasten something securely with ropes or straps is to hold it back or restrain it.

clue.text: Austere-sounding novelist

indicators.note: sounding says the novelist's name is said like the adjective

parts.note: austere means severe, stern

explanation.surface: A writer of severe-sounding prose.
explanation.definitionFit: Laurence Sterne was the eighteenth-century author of the novel Tristram Shandy.

clue.text: Penfriend suffered anguish to win female? That's ill-considered!

parts.note: a pen is a female swan, so her friend is the male swan, a cob
to bleed is to suffer anguish, as a heart bleeds
to is taken as written
to win is to get or obtain
her is the female pronoun

explanation.surface: A pen pal pining to win a woman's heart: a rash plan.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Penfriend' looks like a correspondent, but a pen is a female swan and her mate is a cob.
explanation.definitionFit: Something hastily assembled, roughly put together, is ill-considered and makeshift.

clue.text: Trace of rawness initially found in meat

indicators.note: the initial is found inside the meat word

parts.note: steak is a cut of meat

indicators.note: initially picks the first letter of rawness

explanation.surface: A hint of rareness is detected in a cut of beef.
explanation.definitionFit: A streak is a thin line or trace of something, as a streak of cruelty.

clue.text: The Castilian comes into part of the story

indicators.note: the Spanish article enters the part word

parts.note: a ration is a portion or allotted part
el is the Spanish (Castilian) for the

explanation.surface: A Spaniard enters part of a narrative.
explanation.definitionFit: A relation is a telling or account, a narrative, as in the relation of events.

clue.text: Coppers eat fish, endlessly showing good sense

indicators.note: the coppers swallow the trimmed fish, eating it

parts.note: coppers are pennies, pence

indicators.note: endlessly drops the final letter of the fish word

parts.note: the rudd is a freshwater fish

explanation.surface: Policemen eating fish show common sense.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Coppers' suggests police but means coins, the pennies of British money.
explanation.definitionFit: Prudence is caution and wise judgment in practical matters.

clue.text: Cute, if led astray, becoming two-faced

indicators.note: led astray signals the letters go wandering into a new order

explanation.surface: A cute person, if misled, turns two-faced.
explanation.walkthrough: 'led astray' reads as a phrase, but 'led' is fodder and only 'astray' is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A two-faced person is dishonest and full of lies, deceitful.

clue.text: Dashes to embrace live artist

indicators.note: the dashes word wraps around the live word, embracing it

parts.note: dashes are short runs
to live is to be, exist

explanation.surface: Rushing to hug a painter in person.
explanation.definitionFit: Peter Paul Rubens was the Flemish Baroque painter.

clue.text: Trades in plants

definitions.meaning: ... as a verb: a shop ... goods it sells

explanation.surface: Dealing in plants, as a nursery does.
explanation.definitionFit: A shop that sells goods keeps them in supply; the gillyflower is a fragrant garden plant of this name.

clue.text: Hunting down Tory leader's sport

indicators.note: the leader of Tory is its first letter

parts.note: horse racing is a sport

explanation.surface: The Conservative leader's sport is hunting down quarry.
explanation.definitionFit: To trace someone is to track or hunt them down.

clue.text: Officer in a rush to inflict punishment …

indicators.note: the officer goes in the rush word

parts.note: a surge is a sudden rush
CO is commanding officer

explanation.surface: An officer hurries to discipline a soldier.
explanation.definitionFit: To flog or whip someone is to punish them severely.

clue.text: I can head out for estate

indicators.note: out means the letters are put out of their order

explanation.surface: Someone resolving to leave for a country property.
explanation.definitionFit: A hacienda is a large estate or ranch in Spanish-speaking lands.

clue.text: … concealing punishment

definitions.meaning: keeping something out of sight, putting it away
a thrashing or beating, a good tanning

explanation.surface: Continuing the previous clue: keeping quiet about the beating.
explanation.definitionFit: Hiding is keeping out of sight; a thrashing is also called this colloquially.

clue.text: Crook finds Tories more encouraging

parts.note: C stands for Conservative, the Tories
rosier means more hopeful or encouraging

explanation.surface: A criminal finds the Conservatives' prospects brighter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Crook' looks like a criminal but is a bishop's hooked staff.
explanation.definitionFit: A bishop's hooked pastoral staff, shaped like a shepherd's crook, carries this name.

clue.text: Expel director and spirit abroad

parts.note: rum is a spirit
abroad means out and about, outside

explanation.surface: Throwing out the boss and the overseas liquor.
explanation.definitionFit: To drum someone out is to expel them in disgrace, originally from a regiment.

clue.text: Scholar to tamper with decaying plant

parts.note: an MA, Master of Arts, is a scholar
to rig is to tamper with or fix
decaying suggests aged, old

explanation.surface: An academic meddles with a rotting flower.
explanation.definitionFit: An orange-flowered garden flower of the daisy family is a familiar plant.

clue.text: Stop a queen revealed to be dense

indicators.note: revealed points to letters lying in plain sight inside the words

explanation.surface: Halting a monarch who proves rather stupid.
explanation.definitionFit: Opaque means not letting light through, and so dense, thick or obtuse.

clue.text: Cadet's badly behaved

indicators.note: badly signals the cadet's letters arranged in a wrong order

parts.note: the word cadet supplies the fodder; the apostrophe-s is 'is', a link, giving no letters

explanation.surface: A trainee officer has misbehaved.
explanation.definitionFit: To act a certain way is to behave or conduct oneself so.

clue.text: After I find one, it becomes a mathematical process

indicators.note: becomes signals the whole run of letters turning into something new

explanation.surface: Someone finding one item, which then turns into a calculation.
explanation.walkthrough: The fodder is all fifteen letters of 'After I find one, it'.
explanation.definitionFit: Finding a derivative in calculus is this mathematical operation.

clue.text: Sportsman gets umpire to write up in retrospect

indicators.note: looking back, the combined letters are read in reverse order

parts.note: a ref is a referee, an umpire
to log something is to write it up in a record

explanation.surface: An athlete has the referee keep a record afterwards.
explanation.definitionFit: A player of the club-and-ball game on a course is one kind of sportsman.

clue.text: Believe King Charles's correct

parts.note: CR is Carolus Rex, King Charles
to edit is to correct text

explanation.surface: Trust that the King is right.
explanation.definitionFit: To credit a story is to accept it as true, to believe it.
